findings.text: blocking: the node's stated goal is the tangent of every polygon vertex and edge residual term the Biot point jet differentiates, and the run's declared scope names nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py first, but neither the delta 553c9fadf..37a6fb7ad nor the run's whole diff e74d8fce..37a6fb7ad touches it: git diff --name-only e74d8fce..37a6fb7ad returns zero polygonanalytic lines. The delivered tangents cover momentchannel.factorise, _pole_contraction and Channel.across plus gradedresidual.graded_residual, _regularised and _model_integral only, and the fragment still lists the _Vertex and _Edge residual terms, arsinh_terms, flux_moment_residuals, Channel.split and the packed_analytic_moments jaxpr enumeration as outstanding, asserting a separate node owns them though no plan node is named. Unchanged by the delta; carried from the prior review of this run.

follow-on: the summary states the two modules gain 0 deleted and 449 added lines, but git diff --numstat e74d8fce..37a6fb7ad over nova/biot/momentchannel.py and nova/biot/gradedresidual.py reports 288 and 210 added lines and 0 deleted, 498 added in total (the prior fragment at 553c9fadf stated 429 against an actual 491). The number does not reconcile with the tree it describes, and the delta's own +7 change is stated as +20.

follow-on: the changed module has no completed head suite log: final-head-test_vertex_edge_tangent_recurrences.log holds only 19 passing dots, no pytest summary and no EXIT line, because suite-delta.sh's 900 s timeout killed it -- naming the path clears the repository's default not-slow filter, so the module's own seven compile rows (21 cold processes each) run too. The manifest's after_suite names the elliptic log (28 passed, EXIT=0) and reports completed true, a true statement about that log that leaves the changed module's own head arm unread; the manifest does disclose the incomplete arm in its tests line, and an independent run of the not-slow rows (15 passed) and the three highest compile rows (3 passed) covers the gap.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit: ea273e859 replaces min-of-3 with median-of-7 and asserts the expanded equation count identical across the seven processes; a1f33791d shares one reciprocal square per element and drops two output selects that were already exact zeros, trimming the factorise tangent from 198 to 184 equations; 37a6fb7ad rewrites the fragment's compile table to median-of-seven with equation counts.
item_verdicts.done_when: done-when (2) identity reproduces exactly (15 passed; maxima factorise 0, pole_contraction 1.160e-15, mirrored 8.584e-15, across 5.954e-16, model_integral/regularised/graded_residual 0; covered fraction 1.000; base jvp finite 1.0000), the control fires (NOVA_TANGENT_TRUNCATION=1, 7 failed EXIT=1), and done-when (4) is now met where the prior review found it breached -- an independent run at 37a6fb7ad of the three highest compile rows passed (factorise median 1.88, graded_residual 2.73, across 2.74) and the run's two full arms passed every row at 1.64-2.85 -- but done-when (1) remains only partly met with no polygon term and no Channel.split.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is the tangent of every polygon vertex and edge residual term the Biot point jet differentiates; this review covers only the three commits gained since the prior review (553c9fadf..37a6fb7ad), which trim the factorise tangent (a1f33791d), judge compile cost on the median of seven cold processes (ea273e859) and record the median rows with equation counts in the fragment (37a6fb7ad). None touches nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py, so the namesake vertex and edge residual tangents remain undelivered: the diff adds tangents for momentchannel.factorise, _pole_contraction and Channel.across and gradedresidual.graded_residual, _regularised and _model_integral only, and the fragment still lists the vertex and edge terms and Channel.split as outstanding.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; its commits line lists twelve commits ending 37a6fb7ad, its changed_paths match the diff, its after_suite now names the reviewed head 37a6fb7ad where the prior review found a non-head revision, and its baseline_suite and after_suite both record zero failures on logs that ran to their summary lines.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the delta touches only docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/cfs-vertex-edge-tangent-recurrences.html, nova/biot/momentchannel.py and tests/biot/test_vertex_edge_tangent_recurrences.py (git diff --name-only 553c9fadf..37a6fb7ad), all inside the run's six declared paths with nothing outside.

justifications.durability: the compile guard now certifies the claim it exists to check: median-of-seven with an asserted identical expanded equation count removes the process-spawn variance that produced the prior 3.23 at factorise, the two run arms and my independent run agree, and the identity and control remain self-falsifying against jax.jvp of the base loaded from git at e74d8fce.
justifications.evidence: the identity maxima are reproduced exactly and independently (15 passed), the control's seven failures and their maxima match the fragment, and the compile bound the prior review found breached is now met and independently reproduced (factorise 1.88, graded_residual 2.73, across 2.74 under a fresh median-of-seven). Two defects remain in the record: the fragment's added-line count is 449 where the diff is 498, and the changed module's own head suite arm is an incomplete log.
justifications.fit: the perf change is local to _factorise_tangent, the added helpers stay private and follow the module idiom, and the comments state the mechanism (one reciprocal square per element; each shift's tangent is already zero off its own live mask) rather than any plan or stage label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: momentchannel and gradedresidual carry correct hand-written tangents that reproduce jax.jvp of the base, but the node's namesake deliverable -- the polygon vertex and edge residual tangents -- is untouched by the delta and undelivered at this head: no polygonanalytic.py line changes and Channel.split is absent, so the fragment's own title and summary read vertex and edge terms outstanding.
justifications.reuse: the delta reduces one duplication locally by sharing leading_square and gap_square across each element's two quotients, but the standing duplication is unchanged: _product_tangent and _quotient_tangent remain re-declared in gradedresidual.py and momentchannel.py though nova/biot/completeelliptic.py already carries them and the done-when directs reusing the elliptic tangents.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 553c9fadf..37a6fb7ad lists exactly the fragment, nova/biot/momentchannel.py and tests/biot/test_vertex_edge_tangent_recurrences.py, all inside the run's declared scope, with nothing outside and no unrelated file touched.
